onset.Description: Time of the stimulus onset in seconds relative to the beginning of the experiment t=0.

duration.Description: Duration of the stimulus presentation in seconds.

trial_type.Description: The condition of the stimulus being presented in a given block

Levels.experimental_trial: Videos of two creatures moving around in an environment. This is the condition that will be modeled in the main analysis.
Levels.attention_check: Low ambiguity videos of two creatures moving around in an environment. The participant is asked to describe the creatures` relationship after each trial. Responses are used to check if the participant is paying attention.

identifier.Description: The name of the movie file that is presented on a given trial.

response.Description: These responses are collected after the attention_check trials to make sure that the participant is paying attention. These trials will be regressed out in the Main Analysis.
